module: Offline task runner: reads a JSON file `/work.json` containing a list of work items ({type=..., ...}) and runs them one by one (compiling .dae meshes into .cdae, compiling imposters, rendering vehicle previews, testing mods, performance measurements, ESC calibration), then quits the game with `shutdown(0)` when no job is running anymore. Intended for automated launches (command line), not for normal gameplay.
notes: The work starts only after 120 render frames (frame counter in onPreRender).
Recognized task types: compileMesh, testImage, compileImposters, testMod, renderVehiclePreview, testVehiclesPerformances, calibrateESC. An unknown or missing type is logged as an error.
The extension sets itself to manual unload mode (setExtensionUnloadMode(M, 'manual')).
Bug: in loadWork, if /work.json is unreadable, workItems is nil and `#workItems` then causes a Lua error.
The file also contains local functions (loadMaterialsInPath, compileDae) that are not exported: compileDae calls compileCollada then Engine.Render.updateImposters(false).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Sets the extension to manual unload, loads the extensions test/renderVehiclePreview, util/saveDynamicData, util/calibrateESC and util/compileImposters, then reads the task file.

onJobDone.desc: Hook called when a job of the job system finishes: if the tasks have already been queued and no job remains, quits the game (shutdown(0)).

onPreRender.desc: After 120 frames, runs all the work items via the N table, then, when core_jobsystem has no running job left, stops the game.

N.desc: Table of task handlers, keyed by the `type` field of a work.json item. Each method receives the item `w` (JSON table).

compileMesh.desc: Loads the materials from the folder of w.filename, then compiles this .dae file into .cdae (with a *meshes.json file). Error if w.filename is missing.

w.desc: work item; field filename = path of the .dae

testImage.desc: Checks that w.filename exists; the actual test is not implemented (TODO in the code).

compileImposters.desc: Queues the compilation of the imposters of the levels w.levels via util_compileImposters.

testMod.desc: Calls extensions.test_testMods.work with w.tagid, w.resource_version_id and w.disableSpinScr.

w.desc: work item; fields tagid, resource_version_id, disableSpinScr

renderVehiclePreview.desc: Prints w.vehicles to the log then launches test_renderVehiclePreview.renderVehiclePreview.

testVehiclesPerformances.desc: Launches util_saveDynamicData.work(w.pcFile, w.vehicle) to measure vehicle performance.

calibrateESC.desc: Launches util_calibrateESC.work(w.pcFile, w.vehicle) to calibrate the ESC.
